convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for PFE indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trade execution and smoothing algorithms. Custom indicator with non-standard parameters requires manual replication.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of indicator timeframe
min_rates_total - minimum bars needed before EA trades

other_exits: Long close triggered when PFE[1]>PFE[2] (downtrend detected) and BuyPosClose input is true; Short close triggered when PFE[1]<PFE[2] (uptrend detected) and SellPosClose input is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots (0.1), FREEMARGIN=MM fraction of free margin, BALANCE=MM fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=MM fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=MM fraction of balance minus loss. MM parameter (0.1) is the fraction when not in LOT mode.

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic uses 3-bar PFE comparison: PFE[2] vs PFE[1] determines trend direction, PFE[1] vs PFE[0] determines momentum within trend. Uptrend: PFE[1]<PFE[2] AND PFE[0]>PFE[1] triggers long entry and short close. Downtrend: PFE[1]>PFE[2] AND PFE[0]<PFE[1] triggers short entry and long close. When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick instead of only on new bars. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are passed to trade functions for potential pending order placement. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are input toggles allowing independent enable/disable of each trade direction and action. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit suggests global variable usage for inter-EA coordination.
python_conversion_notes: PFE indicator is not available in standard Python TA libraries - must be implemented from scratch. The Polarized Fractal Efficiency formula: PFE = 100 * sign(close-close[period]) * sqrt((close-close[period])^2 + period^2) / sum(sqrt((close[i]-close[i-1])^2 + 1), i=1..period), then smoothed by XMA. The XMA smoothing (JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) algorithms from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh also need Python implementations. Trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) from TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be replicated including MarginMode position sizing logic. The GlobalVariableDel_ function suggests global variable coordination that may need replacement. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 pips are large - verify whether these are points (not pips) and adjust for 5-digit brokers accordingly.
